summary: CA-002 (current triplet, upstream, dirty and environment freeze): implemented uc/envfreeze.py + CLI env-freeze/env-verify. Collects three-repo 40-char HEADs/branch/upstream/remote_url/remote_ref_sha/push_state/dirty allowlist, toolchain (python/git/node/sqlite3), OS, 21 installed skills (SKILL.md sha256), three-repo config fingerprints, runtime_policy.json fingerprint, and a read-only 49.6GB catalog fingerprint (size/mtime/page1/schema hashes via mode=ro, same mode as the product's readonly canary). The gate is EXACT equality (any field drift -> rc 1), never ancestry: moving HEAD forward or backward both drift. push_state is three-state (pushed/local_only/unverifiable) via verifiable ls-remote (20s bound, TimeoutExpired -> unverifiable infra error); git dubious-ownership is classified infra_error. Freeze artifact published exclusively (CAS replace with force). Independent review round 1 returned changes_required with two blocking findings: F1 (porcelain leading-space strip bug corrupting the first dirty entry) and F2 (ruff format line length) — both fixed with regression tests (66 tests total, 13 envfreeze tests); environment re-frozen (sha 3ce3b50b…). RED-A proved the old closure_gate never checks the exact current triplet (compatibility/current.json pins stale for all three repos, gate green); RED-B proved no upstream registration, no dirty ledger, no env-freeze tooling existed. Product code/config/CI/catalog/roots: zero writes.
